documentation.description:
Snowflake ID generator implementation.
64-bit distributed IDs: 1 unused + 41 timestamp + 10 node + 12 sequence.

Generate a new unique ID from the wall clock.
Raises Clock_Backwards if system time moves backwards.
Raises Epoch_In_Future if the wall clock is earlier than Epoch_MS.
When the 4096-ID budget of the current millisecond is exhausted,
polls the clock until the next millisecond (bounded by 1 ms
wall-clock time), then continues with a reset sequence.

fields.name: Last_Timestamp
fields.description:
Deliberately an unbounded Integer, not the public Sequence subtype:
the budget check compares against Sequence'Last BEFORE incrementing,
so the value stays within 0..4095 â but the unbounded type makes a
regression to increment-first logic visible in review instead of
